page: Microsoft Azure D8as_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dasv7 family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor using the x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs, which map to 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, translating to 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The CPU cache configuration includes 48 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. The underlying virtualization is managed by Microsoft Hyper-V.

This server type does not include any local storage, though it is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not feature any GPUs, and it comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The processor supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 extensions (AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16) and cryptographic acceleration (AES, VAES, and SHA_NI), but lacks Advanced Matrix Extensions.

In benchmark evaluations, the D8as_v7 demonstrates top-tier single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 10% for stress-ng single-core tests. Single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression also achieve top-tier results. However, multi-core performance and memory bandwidth metrics generally fall into the average category. For instance, stress-ng multi-core performance, PassMark CPU score, and uncached memory bandwidth write speeds are within the middle 50%. Large-model LLM prompt processing shows weaker performance, though text generation for smaller models is rated as strong.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the D8as_v7 offers a balanced resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, making it a viable option for general-purpose workloads that require strong single-threaded execution without the overhead of local storage. Best-fit workloads include general-purpose web serving, database operations, redis caching, and lightweight text processing or small-scale language model inference.
description: Microsoft Azure D8as_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine from the Dasv7 family, powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 x86_64 processor running at 4.5 GHz. It provides 8 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of RAM, with no local storage or GPUs. The instance excels in single-core tasks, achieving top-tier results in single-threaded stress-ng, gzip compression, and bzip3 decompression benchmarks. Conversely, its multi-core performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations align with average mid-tier standards. Lacking local storage, it relies on external Premium Storage. This virtual machine is well-suited for general-purpose workloads, static web serving, redis caching, and applications that benefit from strong single-threaded CPU performance and a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio.
